content_patterns: Action-first dashboard: budget status card, alert, then two large quick-action buttons ('Scan Receipt' primary, 'Add Expense' secondary) as stacked icon+label cards. Verbs on buttons ('Scan', 'Add'). Alert copy is direct: 'Overbudget', 'Over Rp 200.000'. 'See All' affordance for full history. Money formatted Indonesian-style with dot separators and 'Rp' prefix; expenses negated ('-Rp 85.000').
notable_interactions: Over-budget status propagated at multiple levels: red progress bar + 'Overbudget' badge on summary card, red alert banner per category, implying tappable alert to view category detail. 'See All' implies full activity list. Large action buttons imply primary scan flow and manual entry. Bottom nav shows active 'Home' pill; content continues behind fixed bottom nav (scrollable).
